name: ILL
summary: The historical Grenoble experiment measured reactor antineutrinos at very short distance from the compact high-flux ILL reactor. Its spectrum and rate are part of the reference dataset used in later discussions of reactor-flux predictions.
detection_principle: An inverse-beta-decay detector used a hydrogen-rich scintillating target with a delayed neutron signature. Reactor-on and reactor-off running separated neutrinos from background at a core distance below ten metres.

results.summary: The experiment measured a reactor spectrum and interaction rate that were later re-evaluated as reactor power and flux calculations improved.

science_scope: The historical ILL experiment, distinct from the later STEREO and Ricochet detectors at the same institute.
